familyRendering: Tactile matte hand-painted materials with fine organic brush grain.
Living 2.5D volume from curved planes, warm soft key light and natural occlusion.
No graphic black contour strokes, glossy plastic finish or flat outlined redraws.
Small restrained cloud emblems relate the family without merging their species or silhouettes.
Transparent composable character masters; preserve each native aspect ratio.

haechiIdentity.body: Lean elongated blue-green body; narrow waist; low-forward pose; all four paws visible.
haechiIdentity.face: Compact folk-mask facial structure with short vermilion nose; no long canine muzzle.
haechiIdentity.eyes: Fully open modest amber eyes, centered dark pupils looking forward, one small catchlight each; thin cloud brows separated from the eyes.
haechiIdentity.markings: Large charcoal spots only. No tiny dots or freckles.
haechiIdentity.ornament: Emerald and warm-orange grooved head locks and layered leaf-fan tail, red flame crests, small gold cloud shoulder emblem.
haechiIdentity.necklace: Gold bell and red leaf pendant beneath the chin.
haechiIdentity.paws: Ivory paws with short dark claws on all four paws.
avoid: Bulky barrel torso or bodybuilder muscles
Sleepy eyelid overlap or exaggerated staring eyes
Wide human grin, lashes, makeup or heavy eyeliner
Literal tracing of a third-party reference composition

haechi.introduction: Role and integration to be designed; not an existing selectable companion.

productionRules: Use these PNGs as visual identity references for derivative poses, crops, posters and animation.
Keep these source masters immutable; add separately named derivatives with provenance.
Design against actual runtime consumers, enum/emotion mapping, dimensions and fallback contracts.
Do not replace current runtime files by copying a full-body master into every slot.
Do not register the source directory in pubspec.yaml as an app bundle.
Recheck live code, Git state and assets before designing or implementing replacement media.
